titre: [$175] [Merge Reports] Suggest Merge Reports when someone moves every expense off a report
corps:
## Problem Merge Reports is useful for a small set of people, at the moment they need it, and they're unlikely to find it on their own. The clearest sign someone needed it is doing a merge by hand: selecting every expense on a report and moving them all to another report. ## Proposal When someone selects **all** the expenses on a report and picks another report to move them to, show a one-time modal **before the move runs**. It does two jobs at once: 1. **Offers the merge now.** They've already chosen the expenses and the destination, which is everything a merge needs, so **Merge reports** merges in one tap. 2. **Teaches where Merge lives for next time.** A move-time offer alone fixes this one move but doesn't teach the feature, so the modal also shows the steps to find it. ### Design **Web** **Mobile** (bottom-docked on narrow screens) ### Copy (all new) | Element | Copy | |---|---| | Title | Merge these reports instead? | | Description | You're moving all the expenses from this report to another one. Merging does it in one step. | | Row 1 | **Next time**, go to **Spend > Reports**, select both reports, and choose **Merge reports**. | | Row 2 | Merging also **deletes the empty report**. | | Buttons | **Just move** (secondary, left) · **Merge reports** (success, right) | - No report names in the copy, because they can be long and make the modal awkward. - Follows CONSISTENCY-19 and the HelpDot naming conventions: sentence case, the exact UI label **Merge reports** in bold, and the whole navigation path **Spend > Reports** bolded as one. ### How it works - **Component:** the `FeatureTraining` modal, like `ChangePolicyEducationalModal`. It has an illustration band, title, description, two 48px illustration rows (`FolderOpen`, `Broom`) and a `ButtonRow` with the two buttons. On narrow layouts it docks to the bottom over the overlay scrim. - **Illustration:** the mockups use `ReceiptWranglerSpaceCowgirl` on a `green700` band. The Submit plan welcome modal already uses this art (on `yellow400`), so design may want different art. - **When it shows:** the person picks a destination in the move-to-report flow (e.g. `SearchTransactionsChangeReport` › `selectReport`, before `changeTransactionsReport` runs), the selection is every expense on a single source report, and a merge would be allowed. Eligibility uses the same rules as `canMergeReports()` (`src/libs/ReportUtils.ts`): - same owner, same workspace, same state and status - processing reports must share the same approver - the user has the `reportMerge` beta while it's still in beta - **Merge reports:** runs `mergeReports()` with the chosen report as the destination and the source report as the only source. - **Just move:** carries on with the move exactly as today. - **Once per account:** record it in `nvp_dismissedProductTraining` under a new key, the same way `CONST.CHANGE_POLICY_TRAINING_MODAL` does. No new NVP is needed. - **Record the outcome:** shown, merged, or moved anyway. ## Testing steps: **Merge via modal:** 1. Create two reports 2. Add 2 expenses to one of the reports 3. Select both expenses 4. Tap/click `More' > `Move to report` 5. Tap/click the other report 6. Verify the modal shows 7. Tap/click `Merge reports` 8. Verify all expenses have been moved and the original report has been deleted **Move via modal:** 1. Create two reports 2. Add 2 expenses to one of the reports 3. Select both expenses 4. Tap/click `More' > `Move to report` 5. Tap/click the other report 6. Verify the modal shows 7. Tap/click `Just move` 8. Verify all expenses have been moved and the original report has NOT been deleted

## Proposal

### Please re-state the problem that we are trying to solve in this issue.
When a user manually selects **every** expense on a single source report and chooses another eligible report in the move-to-report flow, we want to intercept the move once per account with a `FeatureTraining` educational modal that lets them run `mergeReports()` in one tap (**Merge reports**) or continue the standard move (**Just move**), while teaching where Merge Reports lives (**Spend > Reports**).

### What is the root cause of that problem?
This is a new feature enhancement. Currently, [`SearchTransactionsChangeReport.tsx:277-325`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/25e77aeeee078efe59de64fb959c189520585f78/src/pages/Search/SearchTransactionsChangeReport.tsx#L277-L325) (`selectReport`) unconditionally invokes `changeTransactionsReport(...)` whenever a destination report is selected, without checking whether all expenses of a single source report are selected or whether the source and destination reports are eligible for `canMergeReports`.

### What changes do you think we should make in order to solve the problem?
1. **Eligibility & Interception in `SearchTransactionsChangeReport` ([`src/pages/Search/SearchTransactionsChangeReport.tsx:277-325`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/25e77aeeee078efe59de64fb959c189520585f78/src/pages/Search/SearchTransactionsChangeReport.tsx#L277-L325)):**
   - Extract the existing `changeTransactionsReport` + cleanup/navigation flow in `selectReport` into a helper (`performMove`).
   - Before running `performMove`, check whether the one-time suggestion modal should be shown:
     - The modal has not been dismissed in `ONYXKEYS.NVP_DISMISSED_PRODUCT_TRAINING` under a new key (e.g., `CONST.MERGE_REPORTS_SUGGESTION_MODAL`, following `CONST.CHANGE_POLICY_TRAINING_MODAL`).
     - The user has `CONST.BETAS.REPORT_MERGE` enabled (`isBetaEnabled(CONST.BETAS.REPORT_MERGE)`).
     - All selected transactions belong to a **single** reported `sourceReportID` (`!== CONST.REPORT.UNREPORTED_REPORT_ID` and `!== destinationReport.reportID`), and the selected transaction count equals all non-deleted transactions on `sourceReport` (verifying against `sourceReport.transactionCount` / hydrated transactions so filtered partial selections do not falsely trigger a merge).
     - Both `sourceReport` and `destinationReport` are hydrated and eligible using the exact same checks as [`SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx:158-176`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/25e77aeeee078efe59de64fb959c189520585f78/src/pages/Search/SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx#L158-L176): `canMergeReports([sourceReport, destinationReport], currentUserPersonalDetails.accountID, rules, ownerLogin, reportNameValuePairs, selectedPolicy)` and `doReportsHaveMatchingReportFieldValues([sourceReport, destinationReport], selectedPolicy)`.
   - When eligible, store the pending destination item in state to display the modal and record the `shown` outcome instead of calling `performMove` immediately.

2. **One-Time `FeatureTraining` Modal (`MergeReportsSuggestionModal`):**
   - Build a reusable modal following [`src/pages/ChangePolicyEducationalModal.tsx:38-69`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/25e77aeeee078efe59de64fb959c189520585f78/src/pages/ChangePolicyEducationalModal.tsx#L38-L69) using `FeatureTraining` (`FeatureTraining.Illustration` with `ReceiptWranglerSpaceCowgirl` on `colors.green700`, `FeatureTraining.Title`, `FeatureTraining.Description`, two 48px illustration rows with `FolderOpen` and `Broom`, and `ButtonRow` with **Just move** as secondary left button and **Merge reports** as success right button).
   - Dock the modal to the bottom over the overlay scrim on narrow layouts (`shouldUseNarrowLayout`).
   - Add all new copy strings to `src/languages/en.ts` (sentence case, no report names, bolded **Next time**, **Spend > Reports**, **Merge reports**, and **deletes the empty report**).

3. **Modal Actions, Dismissal Persistence & Outcome Tracking:**
   - Add the new dismissal key to `CONST` and `DismissedProductTraining` (`nvp_dismissedProductTraining`), persisting dismissal via `dismissProductTraining(...)` so the prompt shows at most once per account.
   - **Merge reports:** persist dismissal, record the `merged` outcome, collect `allReportsTransactions` for `[sourceReportID, destinationReportID]` (matching [`SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx:86-116`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/25e77aeeee078efe59de64fb959c189520585f78/src/pages/Search/SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx#L86-L116)), invoke `mergeReports({destinationReportID, sourceReportIDs: [sourceReportID], ...})` (matching [`SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx:193-219`](https://github.com/Expensify/App/blob/25e77aeeee078efe59de64fb959c189520585f78/src/pages/Search/SearchReportsMergeReports.tsx#L193-L219)), clear selection, and navigate to the merged destination report.
   - **Just move:** persist dismissal, record the `moved_anyway` outcome, close the modal, and invoke `performMove(pendingDestinationItem)` to run `changeTransactionsReport` identically to today.
   - Record the three outcomes (`shown`, `merged`, `moved_anyway`) using the team preferred telemetry/logging hook (`Log.info` / analytics).

### What alternative solutions did you explore? (Optional)
- *Triggering the modal from a separate navigation screen like `FeatureTrainingModalNavigator`:* Considered, but rendering the `FeatureTraining` modal directly in `SearchTransactionsChangeReport` (with responsive centered/bottom-docked layout) keeps direct access to the hydrated `transactions`, `allReports`, `allReportActions`, and `pendingDestinationItem` needed to immediately invoke either `mergeReports()` or `changeTransactionsReport()` without losing selection state across route transitions.

### Tests
- **Unit tests:** Verify eligibility helper returns `true` only when all non-deleted expenses of a single source report are selected, `canMergeReports` + `doReportsHaveMatchingReportFieldValues` pass, `REPORT_MERGE` beta is enabled, and `nvp_dismissedProductTraining` does not contain the dismissal key; verify partial selections, multi-report selections, unreported expenses, or already-dismissed accounts skip the modal.
- **Manual verification (Web & narrow/mobile):** Execute both testing flows in the issue description (**Merge via modal** confirming original report is deleted, and **Move via modal** confirming original report remains) and confirm the modal does not reappear on a second attempt.
